messages:
Asha Patel: Hey team — Velora Health (acct velora-123) pinging about invoice INV-2026-0423 ($48,600). They requested a one-time 30-day extension and to split into 2 payments. Customer says payroll hits 4/12.

Drew Kim: We showed invoice sent 2063330000 and payment terms were net30. Any prior extensions?

Rajiv Menon: They're a strategic pilot customer; CS has had weekly syncs. They had unexpected refund processing with their finance team.

FinanceBot: Automated reminder: Invoice INV-2026-0423 is 6 days past due. Last emailed 2063400000.

Jordan (CS): Can we do 50/50 split with first payment due 4/12 and second 5/12, waive one late fee ($100) as goodwill? Customer committed to ACH on 4/12. :pray:

Drew Kim: I can approve split + waive one-time late fee pending finance confirmation. Need GL impact: create invoice adjustment for late fee reversal and add payment plan in billing system.

Asha Patel: OK. Action plan: (1) Create credit memo for $100 late fee reversal (GL 4210), (2) Add payment plan: 50% on 2063560000 (4/12) and remainder on 2066152000 (5/12), (3) Mark invoice as 'On plan - do not escalate'.

Drew Kim: Command I'll run:
```
billing-cli payment-plan create --account velora-123 --invoice INV-2026-0423 --schedule "2063560000:24300,2066152000:24300" --note "Split approved by finance; waive late fee"
billing-cli credit-memo create --invoice INV-2026-0423 --amount 100 --gl 4210
```

Rajiv Menon: Adding customer quote: "We'll ACH 4/12 and confirm remittance" — I'll post reminder in our CS thread the day before.

Asha Patel: Perfect. Drew, once you run commands drop the billing-ticket ID here. I'll update collections queue and disable automated escalation for this invoice. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
